title: Comparison of the Body Roundness Index and A Body Shape Index With Body Fat and Visceral Fat in People Living With HIV.
official: Comparison of the Body Roundness Index and A Body Shape Index With Body Fat and Visceral Fat in People Living With HIV: A Pilot Study
summary: The study compares the Body Roundness Index (BRI) and the A Body Shape Index (ABSI) with with body fat and visceral fat in people living with HIV.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with HIV
* Receiving the same anti-retroviral therapy for \>= 6 months.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Having an implantable cardioverters or pacemakers
sponsor: Queens College, The City University of New York
